MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

2. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

4. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 7
   C. 6
   D. 18

5. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

7. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 32
   C. 22
   D. 16

11. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 20
   C. 40
   D. 75

14. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

15. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

16. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 40.5
   C. 9
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
